index.title: AI Academy — Home
index.badge: Platform for building AI mastery skills
index.subtitle: AI Academy helps you master prompts, models, and real workflows through practice with an AI mentor — from your first requests to confident use on the job.
index.login_to_continue: Free registration — access to courses and workspace
index.stat2_label: AI chat tied to each lesson
index.features_lead: The platform is built for practical AI mastery — skills you can apply at work right away, not theory for its own sake.
index.feat1_desc: Write requests so models return accurate, useful answers for your task.
index.feat2_desc: Learn when to use which model and compare outputs in one workspace.
index.feat3_desc: Follow modules step by step: lessons, scenarios, and progress checkpoints.
index.feat4_desc: Verify AI answers, spot hallucinations, and build reliable workflows.
index.feat5_desc: Upload your documents and chat with context from your own materials.
index.feat6_desc: Practice typical tasks — from text analysis to automation — in a safe academy environment.
index.steps_lead: Three steps from sign-up to confident daily use of AI at work.
index.step1_desc: Create an account and open the workspace with courses and the mentor chat.
index.step2_desc: Study material, complete assignments, and get hints in dialogue with AI.
index.step3_desc: Bring what you learned into your projects: prompts, KB, and model comparison at hand.
index.cta_title: Ready to level up your AI skills?
index.cta_desc: Join AI Academy — learn by doing, not by boring slides.
index.welcome_back: Keep building your AI mastery in the workspace.
index.footer: © AI Academy — developing skills to master artificial intelligence
